title: Create a separate Google Calendar with AI
h1: make a separate google calendar for one project
description: Give a project its own Google Calendar. A bot creates a secondary calendar with your title and time zone, ready for you to add events.
keywords: google calendar create secondary calendar with ai
answer: **give a project its own calendar before it crowds your personal one.** a bot can create a secondary google calendar with a title, description, location and time zone. your connected account owns it. name the time zone because the default is utc. creation won't ask first unless you put that instruction in the job.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: give the project its own calendar.
what:
**give rehearsals a home of their own.** this action creates a secondary calendar and its settings. choose the owning account and title, then add a description and location if useful. your primary calendar stays put.

say "paris time" for the time zone; a city in the description won't set it. the default is utc. events and sharing take separate steps, so the calendar starts empty.
uses: **separate touring dates.** keep production planning away from personal appointments.
**start a course intake.** give the new cohort its own calendar and location description.
**contain the office move.** make one temporary home for appointments before people add them.

routine.message:
on the first tuesday of each quarter at 11, read the harrow lane theatre season plans in our project folder. find newly confirmed seasons that name a calendar and don't yet list one.

show the proposed title, description, location and paris time zone here. ask me before you change anything. create only calendars i confirm in my work account. return each calendar's details here. never add events, change sharing or recreate a calendar already listed in a season plan.
routine.when: first tuesday of each quarter at 11:00
routine.needs: access to the season plans folder; google calendar read and write for calendar creation
routine.output:
harrow lane winter rehearsals
owner: connected work account
location: west rehearsal room
time zone: paris time

ready for your review. no calendar created.

steps: **pick the owner first.** connect the right google account and allow calendar creation with read and write.
**name the calendar and zone.** give its purpose too, so the title still makes sense next season.
**put review in the request.** tell the bot to wait before creating anything.
**open the result.** read the owner and time zone in settings. pause the quarterly routine when season intake ends.
watch: **no zone means utc.** a place name in the location field won't change that default.
**choose work or personal before creation.** the connected account owns the new calendar.
**events and sharing are separate.** this action has no sharing setting and doesn't fill the schedule.

faq.q: does this replace my primary google calendar?
faq.a: **no, your primary calendar stays.** the new one is a secondary calendar owned by the connected account.

faq.q: can i name the calendar and set its city?
faq.a: **yes, give a title and optional location.** add a description if useful. set the time zone separately from the city text.

steps: choose the google account that should own it
name one new calendar and its time zone
ask to review its settings before creation
open the new calendar settings before adding events

mistakes.mistake: putting the city only in the description
mistakes.fix: set the time zone too. otherwise the new calendar uses utc.

mistakes.mistake: making a new calendar every quarter regardless
mistakes.fix: read the season plans first. create only for confirmed seasons that need one.

tip.text: get the owner right before planning a season. a calendar title is much easier to fix.
